verdict.rationale: Letta gives users real levers over retention: local mode stores agent state only on the user's machine with no login (letta-docs-31, letta-probe-rt-2), self-hosting keeps all data on infrastructure the user controls (letta-docs-30, letta-docs-38), and --ephemeral mode explicitly avoids creating or persisting any agent, memory, or MemFS data for one-shot tasks (letta-docs-14). However, there is no documented explicit 'delete agent' / 'purge memory' command or data-retention policy for the cloud-hosted option (chat.letta.com, /login backup) — missing for 10: explicit deletion/export commands for cloud-stored agents, documented retention windows or GDPR-style data-deletion guarantees, and any evidence of how backed-up cloud data is removed on request.
